$comment: Sources of the downloadable sound packs (spec 12 P6-R1; wp-note "Phase 6 → WP6.1 sound packs"). `scripts/sounds/curate-packs.ts build` turns this into apps/engine/src/sounds/packs.json: every audio file of each archive (minus the files the starter kit already ships unchanged, Kenney's own byte-identical duplicates and Preview.ogg) with its sha256, size, title, tags and the types of its rule that the judge accepts on the measured file. `rules` match the file name without extension (first match wins); `{1}`… are capture groups; a trailing number becomes the title's number. `strict`: when the judge accepts none of the rule's types the file stays untyped (else it keeps the first). `types: []` = untyped on purpose (music, voice).
author: Kenney (www.kenney.nl)

packs.title: Casino Audio
packs.description: Card, chip and dice foley recorded on a felt table: card fans, slides, shoves, shuffles, chip stacks and dice throws.

rules.title: Cards taken out of the pack

packs.title: Digital Audio
packs.description: Synthesised game sounds: lasers, zaps, phasers, power-ups, tones and digital trash.

packs.title: Impact Sounds
packs.description: Impacts on bell, glass, metal, plates, planks, wood, tin and soft surfaces in light, medium and heavy variants, punches, mining hits and footsteps on five surfaces.

packs.title: Interface Sounds
packs.description: Interface sounds: clicks, toggles, selects, confirmations, errors, questions, open / close / maximise / minimise swooshes, drops, glass pings, plucks, scrolls, scratches and glitches.

packs.title: Music Jingles
packs.description: 85 short musical stings (1–4 s) in five styles: 8-bit, hit, pizzicato, saxophone and steel drums. Music, not effects: they carry no sound type.

packs.title: RPG Audio
packs.description: Foley for adventures: books, cloth, belts, leather, coins, doors and creaks, knives drawn and slicing, metal latches and pots, chopping and footsteps.

packs.title: Sci-fi Sounds
packs.description: Science-fiction sounds: lasers, force fields, explosions, metal impacts, doors, computer noise, slime and space-engine and thruster loops.

packs.title: UI Audio
packs.description: Button clicks, mouse clicks and releases, rollovers and 38 switches.

packs.title: Voiceover Pack
packs.description: Game announcer lines by a male and a female voice: numbers, "Ready", "Go", "Game over", "Level up", "Mission completed" and war-game call-outs. Voice, not effects: they carry no sound type.

packs.title: Voiceover Pack (Fighter)
packs.description: Fighting-game announcer lines by a male voice: "Fight!", "Round 1", "Final round", "Flawless victory", "Combo", "You win" and numbers. Voice, not effects: they carry no sound type.

filePacks.$comment: Packs downloaded file by file from BigSoundBank.com (spec 12 §0 decision 5; wp-note "Phase 6 → BigSoundBank packs"). Human decision 2026-10-17: BigSoundBank is included (its robots.txt / ai.txt keep crawlers and AI training off /UPLOAD/; we train nothing, the engine downloads only these curated files from their upstream URLs when the user installs a pack, one request at a time, at most one per second). Only files whose own page states "License CC0 (public domain): Free and royalty-free" (the site also offers WTFPL; we use the CC0 grant) and whose technical details name Joseph SARDIN as author (alone or with a co-recordist) are listed: `curate-packs.ts fetch` re-checks both on every page, the licences page, and each file's pinned sha256 and size. `types` are candidates: `build` keeps the ones the judge accepts on the measured file (riser and reverse also need their peak in the last 40 %), else the first (or none when `strict`).
filePacks.licensesStatement: This is: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal WTFPL license , which some summarize: Do what you want, I have NOTHING TO DO. Public Domain Dedication.
filePacks.pageStatement: License CC0 (public domain): Free and royalty-free
filePacks.creditNote: No credit is required (CC0). BigSoundBank appreciates “Additional sounds: Joseph SARDIN - BigSoundBank.com” in your credits.

packs.title: BigSoundBank — Keys & Clicks
packs.description: Real recordings by Joseph Sardin: computer-keyboard and typewriter typing (several takes), single keys, mouse and trackpad clicks, switches, camera shutters, clock and metronome ticks, and a few interface blips.

packs.title: BigSoundBank — Foley & Hits
packs.description: Real recordings by Joseph Sardin: page turns, paper tears, maps, a book, cloth flaps and zips, plus punches, a gavel, kitchen-pan and glass hits, snare, hi-hat and toms, door, lid and gate slams and heavy switch clunks.

packs.title: BigSoundBank — Whooshes & Risers
packs.description: Real recordings by Joseph Sardin: sword, rope, tube and arrow swishes, vehicle and train pass-bys, engine accelerations, Shepard-scale, balloon, drum-roll, drone and feedback risers, a reversed recording and tape rewinds, radio sweeps.

packs.title: BigSoundBank — Ambience & Room Tone
packs.description: Field recordings by Joseph Sardin: room tone (apartment, house, ventilation, corridor), interiors (pool, market hall, café, restaurant, station), city streets and squares, forest, countryside, birds, streams, sea, rain and wind beds.

files.title: Train station hall (Gare du Nord, Paris)
files.author: Joseph Sardin (BigSoundBank.com)
